name: HEX to HSL
summary: Convert HEX, RGB, or HSL colors to HSL channels and CSS hsl() syntax — with live sliders.
description: Paste a hex (#rrggbb), rgb(), or hsl() color to see hue, saturation, lightness, classic and modern CSS hsl() strings, and the equivalent HEX/RGB. Adjust HSL sliders to explore nearby colors interactively.

faqs.question: What is modern hsl() syntax?
faqs.answer: CSS Color Level 4 uses space-separated values: hsl(210 50% 50%) instead of commas.

faqs.question: Can I paste hsl() as input?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both hsl(210, 50%, 50%) and hsl(210 50% 50%) are accepted.

faqs.question: Do the sliders change the hex value?
faqs.answer: Yes. Moving hue, saturation, or lightness updates the preview and HEX/RGB outputs in real time.

faqs.question: Is my color uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
